purpose: Source-grounded registry for audio backend research candidates. This file is config-only and does not install, download, load, or run any model.

source_grounding_policy.rule: Record only facts visible in cited project docs, model cards, or license files. If a source does not state a fact, record unknown rather than inferring.

candidates.license_summary: Current project-local provider path. This phase does not revisit ElevenLabs commercial terms or call the provider.
candidates.commercial_use_status: current provider relationship not changed in Phase 4I0
candidates.role_in_project: Current live/provider TTS path. Keep as the high-quality voice path and do not change it in this phase.
expected_risks: commercial/provider terms are outside this local audio registry phase
candidates.recommended_next_phase: No change in Phase 4I0. Compare against local candidates only after offline benchmarks exist.

source_evidence.fact: Project-local provider boundary is the source for live TTS opt-in rules.
Project-local provider client code contains the existing ElevenLabs path; this phase does not edit or call it.

candidates.license_summary: LFM Open License is Apache-2.0-like with a commercial-use revenue threshold. Liquid docs state free commercial use is limited to companies under 10M USD annual revenue; above that requires a paid license.
candidates.hardware_requirements: unknown exact VRAM; sources state 1.5B audio model, BF16, GGUF/CPU-friendly options, and low-latency design but do not state RTX 4070 Super 12GB fit
candidates.windows_support: unknown - cited sources do not explicitly state native Windows support
candidates.wsl_or_linux_required: unknown - cited sources do not state WSL/Linux requirement
candidates.role_in_project: High strategic feasibility candidate for local ASR, local TTS, and future speech-to-speech audio interface. It must not replace the project-owned sales brain, campaign facts, memory ledger, source grounding, or verifier.
expected_risks: English-only support stated on the model card
integration complexity around interleaved audio/text generation
custom LFM Open License commercial threshold
risk of treating a speech-to-speech model as an unverified sales brain
candidates.recommended_next_phase: Liquid feasibility probe only: install/package metadata check first, then gated model download and ASR/TTS/S2S benchmark only after explicit approval.

source_evidence.fact: Repository describes Liquid Audio as speech-to-speech models and documents interleaved generation for real-time speech-to-speech plus sequential generation for ASR/TTS.
Model card identifies LFM2.5-Audio-1.5B as end-to-end audio foundation model with ASR, TTS, interleaved generation, English support, BF16, and LFM Open License v1.0.
Liquid model license docs state commercial use is free under 10M USD annual revenue and paid license is required above that threshold.
Repository license file contains the LFM Open License v1.0 and the 10M USD threshold definition.

candidates.license_summary: Research and non-commercial use are permitted free of charge. Commercial use requires a separate written license from Fish Audio.
candidates.commercial_use_status: commercial_use_requires_separate_license; not product-runtime-clean for this phase
candidates.hardware_requirements: 24GB GPU memory for inference stated in Fish Audio install docs; H200 performance reported for production streaming benchmarks
candidates.windows_support: limited_or_not_targeted - install docs state System: Linux, WSL and warn compile option is not supported on Windows/macOS
candidates.local_install_possible: yes_if_linux_or_wsl_with_required_gpu_and_weights; not installed or tested in this phase
candidates.role_in_project: Prosody and emotion-control design inspiration first. Do not integrate as a local runtime dependency now. Extract backend-neutral inline-control concepts and serving architecture ideas only.
expected_risks: 24GB VRAM requirement exceeds the stated local 12GB target machine
Linux/WSL requirement complicates Windows-first local workflow
commercial license required for product use
Fish tags could leak into unsupported TTS backends if not guarded
voice cloning capabilities require separate consent and safety review before any use
candidates.recommended_next_phase: No model install. Build internal backend-neutral prosody-control policy inspired by Fish tags and validate no tag leakage into live ElevenLabs speech.

source_evidence.fact: S2 page states fine-grained inline prosody/emotion control with tag syntax, multi-speaker control, 80+ languages, model weights, fine-tuning code, and SGLang streaming engine.
Install docs state GPU Memory: 24GB (Inference), System: Linux, WSL, and compile option not supported on Windows/macOS.
Model card states Fish Audio Research License, research/non-commercial use free, commercial use requires separate license, and model size is 5B params.
License file states commercial use requires a separate written license and grants research/non-commercial rights.
Docs describe SGLang production streaming, multi-speaker generation, multi-turn generation, and rapid voice cloning.

candidates.license_summary: Kokoro repository and model card identify Apache-2.0 licensing; model card states Apache-licensed weights can be deployed from production environments to personal projects.
candidates.hardware_requirements: unknown exact VRAM; source states 82M parameters and lightweight architecture but does not state RTX 4070 Super VRAM requirement
candidates.windows_support: partial_source_stated - repository README includes Windows espeak-ng installation guidance; full local benchmark not tested
candidates.local_install_possible: yes_source_states_pip_install_kokoro_usage; not installed or tested in this phase
candidates.role_in_project: Optional local/offline TTS latency and quality benchmark candidate. It may provide provider-independent evidence but must not replace ElevenLabs without latency and listening-quality results.
expected_risks: voice quality may be below ElevenLabs for sales calls
less expressive emotional control than Fish S2
exact Windows setup and hardware latency unknown until local benchmark
G2P/espeak dependency may affect Windows setup
candidates.recommended_next_phase: Kokoro local TTS smoke and latency benchmark in an isolated audio virtual environment, with audio output only to ignored local artifacts.

source_evidence.fact: Model card states Kokoro is an open-weight TTS model with 82M parameters, Apache-2.0 license, and deployable from production environments to personal projects.
Repository describes itself as an inference library for Kokoro-82M and includes usage with pip install kokoro.
Repository README includes Windows espeak-ng installation guidance and a speed parameter in generation usage.
